note: Redo pass after art review 2, 2026-10-30: the art director's free fixes (redo items 1-5 and 7-13; item 6, b_separator, is m3_machines.json). Overrides earlier recipes by name: every sprite here replaces the entry named in its _was, with the same size, fit and anchors. Sources are free recolours and guarded pixel patches of the raw art in art/edits/redo/ ('node scripts/art/recolor.ts art/edits/redo/edits.json' rebuilds them; raw downloads stay untouched; each edit's note says why). The three t_l2_floor_rock_v<n> terrain sheets are the Fungal floor's variants (STYLE 'Floor variety'): the floor sheet with its flat tile 0 replaced by a variant (cracks and moss). The game loads the variants a set has in the atlas and draws one plain tile in four from them, picked by a hash of the tile's vertex (src/render/terrain.ts sheetAt). The water set needs none: its tile 0 is the same flat fill, and the renderer draws every all-floor tile from the rock sheet. Fix pass 4 (2026-10-30) added b_precision_assembler and b_assay_lab: their pale cyan domes recoloured into their own family's accent. It also gave every building sprite with an obvious lit lamp, window, mouth, coil or core a "light" anchor ([x, y, colour, r] in finished sprite pixels, read by art:build into atlas.json "lights", which the renderer glows while the building works), here and in the recipe that wins for each sprite; the "_light" rects stay as notes. No PixelLab generations. Review 3 (2026-10-30, docs/reviews/review-3/art.md): A1 (the crate planks), A13 (the open #090a14 decor outlines and off-ramp colours) and A3 (floor variant sheets for the Surface, the Shallows, the Crystal Depths and the magma, made by recolor.ts from the fixed sheets in art/edits/terrain/: replay terrain-fix.ts --recipe first). Each set's share of plain tiles drawn from its variants is the "variantShare" on its own terrain recipe, which art:build writes to atlas.json. No PixelLab generations.
